wholePhysicalScope: The named current outline measures 18.80 m by 15.54 m. The architectural inventory records a 17.5 m by 15 m original church body, three polygonal apses and a tower at the southwest corner.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the low dome, triple polygonal apses, timber porch and southwest minaret.
limitations: The 2025 published interior image provides dome and window evidence. Exterior heights, stone and brick color, chapel recesses and porch framing are estimated from surveyed descriptions and the named map envelope.
This model represents the standing mosque after the 2024 restoration. Painted interior surfaces, interior tomb furnishings and the separately addressed street fountain are outside scope.
